items.subject: halftone-arc
items.notes: Hex-grid rose #FFA0AA dots on an arc band; dots shrink toward the band edges and ends. Transparent. SVG is the vector source (2,381 circles). Built locally (Pillow).

items.name: Particle stream wave
items.subject: particle-stream
items.notes: Fine dotted strands flowing in a wave, white on the left to rose on the right, converging. Transparent; made for dark grounds (white dots vanish on white). SVG is vector (5,545 circles + 12 paths). Built locally.

items.name: Fine grain tile
items.subject: grain
items.notes: Tileable luminance noise (wrap-safe), black/white pixels at up to ~12.5% alpha. Use as background-repeat at 1x; lower opacity further on light grounds. Built locally.

items.name: Rose under-glow
items.subject: rose-underglow
items.notes: Soft elliptical rose pool with a lighter core, transparent, dithered against banding. Place under glass objects. Built locally.

items.name: Violet-blue light-streak ground
items.subject: violet-streaks
items.notes: Violet #2A004C top-left to deep blue to near-black #0E0F12 right, rose and blue light streaks with screen-blend glow and bokeh, light grain. Matches the highlight-bar reference ground. Built locally.

items.name: Near-black ground with rose glow
